Chapter 328 Snowfield Beast Tide

The Zerg and Protoss joint forces blocked the attack of the Snow Demon army from multiple directions.

The Snow Demon army, which had been in the northern war zone for many years and had never encountered an opponent, seemed to have met its nemesis this time.

In every major battle, the Snow Demon army was beaten by the elusive Zerg and Protoss coalition without any chance to fight back. The Snow Demon chose to retreat and was eventually surrounded and annihilated.

The Zerg and Protoss joint forces attacked everywhere and eliminated the main force of the Snow Demon army at a very fast speed.

After a day of fighting, the control range of the Zerg and Protoss was reduced by more than half, but the main force of the Snow Demon army suffered unprecedented heavy losses.

After the actual control range of the Zerg and Protoss became smaller, the Snow Demon army could no longer use its advantage in manpower to advance quickly. Within a limited range, the Zerg and Protoss joint forces were fast enough to offset the manpower advantage of the Snow Demon army.

But almost all creatures in the entire northern war zone are the combat forces of the Snow Demon Clan, which is an unimaginable number. The Snow Demon Clan's foundation is extremely terrifying.

The number of Snow Demon Clan members is so large that they are spread all over every corner of the northern war zone. The troops lost on the battlefield in the past few days are not worth mentioning to the Snow Demon Clan.

However, the strength of the combined forces of the Zerg and Protoss still attracted enough attention from the Snow Demon Clan.

A secret place in the heart of the evil god camp.

Some senior personnel of the Snow Demon Clan, the Alien Clan, the Demon Clan and the Bear Goblin Clan gathered together.

The two super clans and two senior old clans of the evil god camp had to gather together to exchange information and discuss countermeasures for the problem of the Zerg.

"Combining the intelligence of our four tribes, the Zerg is at least fighting with our four tribes at the same time!"

"You have already fought with the Zerg and suffered some losses. Now the Zerg has reached out to our northern war zone. Our tribe will do its best to contain the Zerg's combat power as much as possible. I hope you can seize the opportunity and launch a counterattack!"

"I don't believe that the Zerg can deal with the full-scale encirclement and suppression of our four tribes at the same time!"

The high-level of the Snow Demon tribe said.

"This Zerg is indeed very mysterious. The development speed is too fast. It cannot be speculated by common sense. Our tribe has suffered a great loss this time!"

The high-level of the Tianwai people frankly admitted that they had suffered a great loss. The Zerg's blow to the Tianwai people was very heavy.

"The combat power of our two tribes is indeed not as good as that of the Zerg army. We can only try our best to delay the troops that the Zerg has deployed in the direction of our two tribes!"

"With the strength of our two tribes, it would be a bit difficult to launch a counterattack!"

The senior leaders of the Bear Goblin tribe said.

Under the pressure of the Zerg army, the Bear Goblin tribe and the Demon tribe have united and organized forces to block the attack of the Zerg army in the sphere of influence of the evil god camp.

After seeing the result of the battle between the aliens and the Zerg, they no longer wanted to compete with the Zerg, but only wanted to do their best to deal with the Zerg.

Such a difficult task of defeating the Zerg army can only be handed over to super tribes such as the aliens and the Snow Demon tribe. They have the will but not the power.

"Don't be so negative! No matter how strong the Zerg is, can they have as many troops as ours? Can they have as many strong men as the four of us combined?"

"As long as we persist, we will eventually consume the Zerg's foundation!"

"But we have discovered a new situation here. There are a large number of powerful combat weapons in the Zerg army, and some strong men who have never appeared before. We must pay more attention to see if other races are involved!"

"If the native camp races in other war zones participate in the Zerg's attack on our race, we must unite with other war zones to do something!"

The Snow Demon Clan's high-level officials announced the news of the Protoss' participation in the war.

The current native race camp is at a disadvantage overall, and the situation in each war zone is not optimistic. If other war zones withdraw forces to support the northern war zone, it will be a good thing for the evil god camp.

The evil god camp can just seize this opportunity to expand the battlefield advantage of another war zone.

"The Zerg and the Goblins have a close relationship. I wonder if those powerful combat weapons were provided by the Goblins!"

"As for the strong, now the war zones have not started a war between the strong. It is not surprising that some of the strong are mobilized!"

The high-level of the Tianwai people explained.

The high-level of the Snow Demon thought for a while before continuing: "There is another situation that needs to be paid close attention to. Some of the Zerg's spiritual divisions seem to have a powerful stealth ability, which cannot be cracked by all kinds of anti-stealth methods of our tribe!"

"And our tribe's innate stealth ability has lost its effect in front of the Zerg army!"

"This shows that the Zerg army's anti-stealth ability is also extremely strong!"

"I don't know if you have a certain understanding of this situation?"

Originally, the stealth talent was one of the most powerful advantages of the Snow Demon Clan, but now it has been completely restrained by the Zerg in this strongest point. Now that it is said, the high-level of the Snow Demon Clan feels a little embarrassed.

But this is indeed crucial intelligence, and the allies must be informed. The Snow Demon Clan also needs the intelligence support of the allies to crack the stealth ability of the Zerg army.

"In our battles with the Zerg army, we have never encountered them using stealth capabilities, but the Zerg army's ability to burrow into the ground is very strong!"

The high-level of the alien tribe exchanged glances with the high-level of the demon tribe and the bear goblin tribe, and responded.

"That is the new ability of the Zerg. Everyone go back and check the information to see if there is any relevant record!"

"If we can find a way to crack it, our tribe is willing to pay a high price in exchange!"

The Snow Demon tribe did not need any anti-stealth means before. They are masters of stealth and have certain anti-stealth capabilities, but this time facing the Zerg army, it is completely insufficient.

"Okay! Let's all go back and look for information to see if there are any effective means available!"

"..."

The high-level of the two super tribes and two tribes in the evil god camp continued to exchange opinions in depth on the Zerg and reached a number of consensuses.

After this meeting, the Snow Demon tribe, the alien tribe, the demon tribe and the bear goblin tribe have actually formed an alliance to deal with the Zerg.

The result of this meeting, Wu Qing soon felt.

The alien race, which had been beaten by the Zerg and was shrinking, and the demon race and bear goblin race, which seemed to be lingering on, regained their spirits and began to fight a large-scale war of attrition with the Zerg army on their respective battlefields.

…

The public battlefield in the southern theater no longer invested new forces. The alien race, which had been passively defending, once again invested a large number of troops from various races in various battlefields.

Such changes suddenly blocked the attack of the armies of various races in the local race camp.

The Zerg, which had already obtained the status of a major race and should not have participated in the public battlefield war, had not stopped because of the existence of the alien race.

A group of Zerg air forces were formed and transmitted to various war zones on the public battlefield through the space transmission channels of various main cities, launching a strong attack on the sphere of influence of the alien race.

Wu Qing's idea was to occupy the entire public battlefield and make the public battlefield the territory of the Zerg.

With the emergence of Zerg and Protoss, the pattern of this world will change rapidly. The original unspoken rules of the public battlefield and the camp war will soon disappear. There is no need to do things according to the original rules.

Wu Qing is destined to make rules.

Zerg air forces transported Zerg workers to various war zones in the public battlefield and built Zerg sub-bases.

With the support of Zerg sub-bases, a large number of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions can quickly control a large number of territories with the assistance of Zerg air forces.

After the aliens increased their manpower investment in various war zones in the public battlefield of the southern theater, they did contain more Zerg air forces, which are the main forces.

But the aliens also sent a large amount of resources to the Zerg, which is enough for the Zerg to form more main air combat forces.

The Zerg and Protoss did not have a deep foundation originally, but it was the constant wars that made the foundation of the Zerg and Protoss become deeper and deeper.

The races in this world also developed through war plunder.

But after the races of this world plunder resources through war, they still need time to accumulate and digest them effectively.

The Zerg and Protoss do not need this process. With resources, they can immediately become strength without consuming time costs.

This is the system exploiting loopholes in this world and performing high-end cheating.

This world actually allows cheating to a certain extent, but the level of cheating in the system is very high, beyond everyone's imagination.

The Protoss did not participate in the war outside the northern theater, and there were few races in this world that could calmly deal with the Zerg army.

A large number of Zerg sub-bases were built in various theaters of the public battlefield in the southern theater, and more Zerg air forces were formed. Countless Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions killed the sphere of influence of the alien race.

However, because Wu Qing invested the main resources of the system in the northern theater, it would be difficult for the Zerg to quickly occupy the entire public battlefield in the southern theater while the alien race continued to invest troops.

Wu Qing was not in a hurry. When he was ready to attack the northern theater with all his strength, he no longer pursued the development speed in other directions.

…

The situation is similar in the sphere of influence of the demons and bugbears in the evil god camp.

The demons and bugbears changed their normal state and became more active in fighting against the Zerg army.

Wu Qing did not continue to invest too many system resources in this direction, and the Zerg army's offensive was not very strong.

Now that the demons and bugbears have exerted their strength, the Zerg army's offensive has become slower.

Through the sudden changes of the aliens, demons and bugbears, Wu Qing has guessed that the Snow Demons have united with the super tribes and tribes of these evil god camps.

The super tribe aliens are an obstacle. On the demon and bugbear side, Wu Qing does not need to invest more resources to continue to suppress the armies of the two tribes.

The changes in the three evil god camp races will not cause much trouble to Wu Qing, but in the eyes of the four major races of the evil god camp, the goal has been achieved by restraining and continuously consuming a large number of Zerg troops.

The real home ground is still in the northern war zone. The Snow Demon Clan has a special status in the evil god camp. Its true foundation is probably not comparable to that of the other three clans combined.

The Snow Demon Clan is the true descendant of the evil god, which is incomparable to the aliens, demons, and bugbears who are just followers of the evil god.

……

In the northern theater, the Snow Demon Clan, which was truly in action, instantly set off a snow beast tide.

Countless creatures living on the snowfields around the Zerg and Protoss joint base, regardless of their strength, were recruited by the Snow Demon Clan and rushed to the Zerg and Protoss joint base area.

This was a beast tide that was much larger than the number of Zerg puppies and Zerg three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions. A large number of powerful Snow Demon Clan were hidden in the beast tide.

Faced with such a large number of enemies, the Zerg and Protoss joint army had no time to clean up. Wu Qing once again sent out the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to fight against the beast tide that had already passed through the Zerg and Protoss joint army.

The snow creatures of varying strengths, of course, could not beat the powerful Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, but the small number of Snow Demons hidden in them cast powerful ice system magic, and the lethality was very terrifying.

The Snow Demon Clan wanted to compete in military strength, but Wu Qing was not afraid, as the system resources were now sufficient.

More Zerg and Protoss joint armies were formed, and many seven-star Protoss Dragon Knights joined the Zerg Hounds and Type 3 Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpions.

The Protoss Dragon Knights with seven-star strength participated in blocking the snow beast tide, and the effect was very good. With the anti-stealth capabilities of the Zerg host and the Protoss unmanned probe spacecraft, as long as the Snow Demon appeared in the beast tide, it would be killed by the Protoss Dragon Knights.

The seven-star Protoss Golden Beetle also came to the front line through the Protoss transport plane and joined the battle to block the beast tide.

It was really a bit of a waste of talent to use the seven-star ultra-long range and large-scale attack Protoss Golden Beetle to fight the snow beast tide.

Countless unmanned self-destructing aircraft became the nightmare of all snow creatures.

Wu Qing also hatched a large number of Zerg queens with low star strength, controlling snow creatures everywhere and letting them kill each other.

Many ferocious snow creatures, after killing with bloodshot eyes, began to riot, forgetting the orders of the Snow Demon Clan and attacking other creatures when they encountered them.

Wu Qing also hatched a lot of the ultimate Zerg troops, such as Zerg Scorpions and Zerg Mammoths, and sent them to the front line of the beast tide, using their powerful abilities to participate in blocking the beast tide.

Wu Qing had been fighting against the beast tide and was very clear about the horror of the beast tide.

The northern war zone is so large, and the number of snow creatures living in it can be imagined. As long as the Snow Demon Clan mobilizes a small part of them, it will be enough for the Zerg and Protoss to kill for a long time.

With the Zerg troops as the main force and the Protoss troops as the auxiliary, a continuous battle against the beast tide began.

The growing Zerg and Protoss joint army did not participate in the fight against the beast tide, but took the initiative to attack and find the main force of the Snow Demon Clan for a decisive battle.

No matter where the Snow Demon Clan army hides, it cannot escape the eyes of the Zerg and Protoss.
